text: Tank water only. Roofs: garage, carport and house. The 5,000 L tank collects rain from the carport and half the garage (36 m²); it has a tap for filling the watering can and is not connected to the pump. The 30,000 L tank collects from half the garage (18 m²) plus the entire house roof (173 m²), 191 m² in all, with the electric pump from this tank. Tank overflow is taken to the gutter on the front street. Leaf guards professionally installed on all gutters. Greywater: laundry water is diverted to the east garden via hose.
